343469.title: The generalized 2-adic valuation conjecture for weighted Catalan numbers
343469.prior_campaign_history: No substantive prior campaign note: exact-ID grep of campaign *.md/*.json/*.txt found only corpus copies, routing/coverage lists and coincidental numeric strings (see SUMMARY.md, History check).
343469.review_depth: full source definition (Def. 1.1, Fig. 1) and Conjecture 4.12 read; exhaustive computation
343469.outcome: LITERAL REFUTATION AT AN ENDPOINT (finite certificate); recommended zero credit as an endpoint correction
343469.source_statement: Gao-Gu, Arithmetic of weighted Catalan numbers, arXiv:1908.03914v1 (only version), Conjecture 4.12: weight b(x)=(2x+1)^{2k}; exists 2-adic alpha_k and nonnegative integer c_k with xi2(L_n^(k)-C_n)=s2(n)+xi2(n-alpha_k)+c_k for all n>=2. Weighted Catalan number = sum over Dyck paths of product of b(height) over up-steps.
343469.mechanism: e(n)=xi2(L_n-C_n)-s2(n) computed exactly/mod 2^64 by height DP, cross-checked by exact continued-fraction series and brute-force Dyck enumeration (n<=11/12). A 2-adic fit exists iff the sets {n: e(n)-c>=j} are nested single residue classes mod 2^j.
343469.finding: For k=2 the printed statement is false: e(2)=3, e(3)=11, e(4)=3, e(5)=4, e(19)=8 (L_3^(2)=57349, L_3-C_3=7*2^13). alpha even would force e(3)=e(5); so alpha odd, c=e(2)=3; xi2(3-alpha)=8 forces xi2(19-alpha)=4, but e(19)-3=5. Same failure for every k = 2 mod 4 tested (k=2,6,...,30), always and only at n=3: from n=4 on a consistent (alpha_k,c_k) exists for all k<=32 through n<=600 (k<=8 through n<=1100), with c_k = xi2(k)+2. k=1 reproduces Postnikov alpha=...010111_2, c=2.
343469.credit_assessment: The failure is a single small value n=3 against a printed range n>=2 copied from Postnikov Conjecture 4.11; the evidently intended statement (n>=4, or n>=2 for k not = 2 mod 4) survives all tests. This is an endpoint/range correction in the sense of the brief (zero credit). Full proof of the intended statement would subsume Postnikov Conjecture 4.11 (open since 2000) and is not reachable here.
343469.precise_remaining: Prove the n>=4 statement (even k=1 is Postnikov's open conjecture). If root nonetheless wants the literal refutation: Lean plan = define weighted Catalan by Dyck-path sum, prove a height-DP bridge lemma, evaluate n in {2,3,4,5,19} with Nat GMP kernel arithmetic, and derive the contradiction with padicValInt / PadicInt (Z_[2]); not drafted because the item is not recommended for credit.

349179.title: Prime-order balanced shift-pattern coloring conjecture
349179.prior_campaign_history: No substantive prior campaign note: exact-ID grep of campaign *.md/*.json/*.txt found only corpus copies, routing/coverage lists and coincidental numeric strings (see SUMMARY.md, History check).
349179.review_depth: source definitions (Sec. 2, 4.1 shift pattern, Fig. 3) and Conjecture 11 read; cited Fenner et al. Theorem 3.14 proof read
349179.outcome: RESOLVED BY A CONSTRUCTION PRINTED IN A CITED PAPER (zero credit, lesson 372630)
349179.source_statement: Liu-Chew-Heule arXiv:2012.12582v1 Conjecture 11: for k prime there is a k-coloring of G_{k^2,k^2} with shift pattern on k-subgrids (each row of a k x k subgrid is the previous row cyclically shifted, all subgrids in the same direction) such that each color occurs exactly k times in each subgrid.
349179.mechanism: Rows (x1,x2), columns (y1,y2) over F_k, block = (x1,y1). Fenner-Gasarch-Glover-Purewal (arXiv:1005.3750, the source's reference [5]) Theorem 3.14 (Berg/Vivas) colors COL=x1*y1+x2+y2 and proves rectangle-freeness. Inside block (x1,y1) the color depends on x2+y2 only, so the next row is the previous one shifted left by one (a left shift pattern) and each color occurs exactly k times. Equivalently chi=(j-i-ab) mod k gives a right shift.
349179.finding: Conjecture 11 holds for every prime k (indeed with F_q the same works for the shift as an F_q-translation, but the cyclic shift needs k prime). Verified by computer for k=2,3,5,7,11,13; the cyclic formula fails for k=4,6,8,9 as expected.
349179.credit_assessment: All ingredients (the coloring and its rectangle-freeness proof) are printed in a paper the source cites; only the observation that it is already shift-patterned and balanced is new. Zero credit.
349179.search_coverage: k in {2,...,13} checked exhaustively for rectangles.
